<!-- en -->
v0.2.1 is a feature and maintenance release: dashboard privacy masking and configurable full-page screenshot sharing, data-freshness indicators on the dashboard, collection fixes for compressed Codex rollouts and OpenCode V2 totals, and serve background logs moving into the configured log directory. No command contracts break in this release.

### Highlights
- **Share your dashboard without leaking project names.** A privacy-mask toggle on the Dashboard page renders project names and session titles as `***` everywhere they appear (dimension rows, composition views, custom-view tables, and the session table; the aggregated "other" rows and the "(uncategorized)" placeholder are never masked). Masking is display-only — the HTTP API responses and the raw data in the browser stay plaintext. A full-page **Share screenshot** composes one PNG — the brand header, the selected date range, and the headline metrics are always included; the dimension list and composition views, the trend and heat charts, each configured custom view, and the top sessions are selectable. The dialog starts from the page's current mask state, its in-dialog toggle affects that image only, content selections are remembered per browser, and the preview is exactly the PNG copied to the clipboard.
- **Collection stays complete on two new source shapes.** Codex rollouts compressed by `local_thread_store_compression` (`*.jsonl.zst`) are now collected — v0.2.0 silently skipped them — with streaming zstd decode, dual-form discovery dedupe, and state path resolution. After upgrading, the daemon's startup catch-up scans existing plain and compressed rollouts; `collect all` recollects the threads still registered in the state database and resolves their compressed files. OpenCode 2.x messages whose `tokens.total` is missing or `null` are now booked with a total derived from the upstream five-part sum, instead of being deferred with a partial-failure report every round.

### New & Changed
- **Dashboard privacy masking**: off by default; a page reload resets it, while auto refresh, manual refresh, and range changes keep the current state. Turning it on also closes any open full-title dialog. The screenshot dialog inherits the page's mask state on open; its toggle is per-image and never persisted. `client`, `model`, and `provider` dimensions are not masked.
- **Data freshness**: `GET /api/dashboard` now returns `data_through` (the latest message time in the whole database) and `last_collection` (the last successful collection time), `null` when absent, from the same read snapshot as the statistics; the page shows both in its header so you can tell how current the numbers are.
- **Serve background logs** now go to `serve.log` under the effective `log.dir` (defaulting to `<data_dir>/logs`, giving `~/.token-usage/logs/serve.log` with defaults). The per-start truncation, the failure log tail, and update restoration are unchanged. The old `<data_dir>/serve.log` is not moved or deleted automatically — remove it manually once the old instance has exited.
- **Documentation**: the dashboard now has its own guide — `docs/dashboard.md` / `docs/dashboard.zh-CN.md` — covering the page behavior, the Config page, privacy masking and screenshot sharing, and the HTTP API (the API payload contract lives there now; the CLI Reference keeps the `serve` command family with cross-links in both directions). Alongside the split, stale claims accumulated since earlier versions were corrected in both languages: the migration table no longer points removed commands (`forecast`, `compare`, the SVG chart export) at the dashboard, the uninstall steps now stop the dashboard and clean up installer-managed shell completion (including the `ZDOTDIR` form), the install layout no longer promises that the database and logs always live under `~/.token-usage`, router support is listed as Claude and Codex, WorkBuddy's SQLite metadata role and the dependency graph match the code, and the README presents the dashboard as the headline feature.

### Fixed
- **Compressed Codex rollouts are collected again.** With Codex's `local_thread_store_compression` enabled, rollouts untouched for 7 days are compressed into single-frame `*.jsonl.zst` files and the original `.jsonl` is deleted; v0.2.0's scan path silently skipped these files and the state thread paths went stale. Discovery now recognizes both forms (deduplicating the logical name), the reader streams zstd frames, and state paths resolve to their sibling form. Verified with a real daemon startup sweep; separately, 312 real compressed sessions were compared session-by-session against the pre-compression `.jsonl` originals — message counts, per-message IDs, timestamps, token fields, and DurationMS all matched.
- **OpenCode V2 totals are derived instead of deferred.** v0.2.0 left terminal V2 messages with usage but a missing or `null` `tokens.total` unbooked — every round reported a partial failure and kept the cursor for retry. The total is now derived from the same five-part sum the upstream `total()` computes, at a single derivation point; V2 sessions book normally and the periodic partial failures stop.
- **`log.dir` values with surrounding whitespace no longer split paths.** The configured log directory is now trimmed and `~`-expanded once and shared by the daemon, autostart, fallback, and serve paths; previously a value with stray spaces could resolve differently per consumer.

### Installation
See the [README Quick Start](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage#quick-start). Existing users update in place with `token-usage update`.

<!-- zh -->
v0.2.1 是一次功能与维护版本：仪表板隐私遮蔽与可配置的整页截图分享、数据新鲜度指示、压缩 Codex rollout 与 OpenCode V2 total 两项采集修复，以及 serve 后台日志归位到配置的日志目录。本版本没有破坏性的命令合同变更。

### 亮点
- **放心分享仪表板，不再泄露项目名。** 仪表盘页新增隐私遮蔽开关：开启后项目名称与会话标题在其出现的所有位置（维度行、构成视图、自定义视图表与会话表）显示为 `***`（聚合「其他」行与「(未分类)」占位不遮蔽）。遮蔽是纯展示层——HTTP 接口响应与浏览器中的原始数据仍为明文。整页**分享截图**合成一份 PNG：品牌头部、所选统计区间与概要指标固定包含；维度列表与构成视图、趋势与热力图表、每个已配置的自定义视图、用量最高的会话均可勾选。弹窗打开时继承页面当前遮蔽状态，弹窗内开关只影响本次图片；内容勾选按浏览器记忆；预览所见即复制到剪贴板的那份 PNG。
- **两种新源形态下采集保持完整。** Codex `local_thread_store_compression` 压缩的 rollout（`*.jsonl.zst`）现在会被采集——v0.2.0 会静默跳过——支持流式 zstd 解码、双形态识别去重与 state 路径解析。升级后，daemon 启动补采会扫描现存的明文与压缩 rollout；`collect all` 则重新采集 state DB 中仍登记的线程，并解析其压缩文件。OpenCode 2.x 中 `tokens.total` 缺失或为 `null` 的消息现在按上游同源的五分项之和派生 total 入账，不再每轮暂缓并报告部分失败。

### 新增与变更
- **仪表板隐私遮蔽**：默认关闭；页面重新加载后重置，自动刷新、手动刷新与切换区间保持当前状态；开启时也会关闭已打开的完整标题弹窗。截图弹窗打开时继承页面遮蔽状态，弹窗内开关只对本次图片生效、从不持久化。`client`、`model`、`provider` 维度不遮蔽。
- **数据新鲜度**：`GET /api/dashboard` 新增 `data_through`（全库最新消息时间）与 `last_collection`（最近成功采集时间），缺数据时为 `null`，与统计结果出自同一读快照；页面顶部一并显示，一眼可知数据有多新。
- **serve 后台日志**写入生效 `log.dir` 下的 `serve.log`（默认 `<data_dir>/logs`，缺省数据目录下即 `~/.token-usage/logs/serve.log`）。每次启动截断、失败附带日志末尾、update 恢复路径等语义不变。旧 `<data_dir>/serve.log` 不会自动搬移或删除——旧实例退出后可手动清理。
- **文档**：仪表板拥有独立指南 `docs/dashboard.md` / `docs/dashboard.zh-CN.md`——覆盖页面行为、配置页、隐私遮蔽与截图分享、HTTP 接口（API 载荷合同以此为准；CLI 参考保留 `serve` 命令族，双向互链）。随拆分一并修正了两个语言版本中自早期版本累积的过时表述：迁移表不再把已移除的命令（`forecast`、`compare`、SVG 图表导出）指向仪表板，卸载步骤补上停止仪表板与安装器写入的 Shell 补全清理（含 `ZDOTDIR` 形态），安装布局不再声称数据库与日志「始终」在 `~/.token-usage`，路由支持更正为 Claude 与 Codex，WorkBuddy 的 SQLite 元数据角色与依赖图对齐代码现状，README 把仪表板提为首位亮点。

### 修复
- **压缩 Codex rollout 恢复采集。** Codex 开启 `local_thread_store_compression` 后，7 天未动的 rollout 被压缩成单帧 `*.jsonl.zst` 并删除原 `.jsonl`；v0.2.0 的扫描路径静默跳过这些文件，state 线程路径也随之失效。发现层现在识别双形态并按逻辑名去重，读取层流式解码 zstd 帧，state 路径解析到兄弟形态。已通过真实 daemon 启动全扫验证；另将 312 个真实压缩会话与压缩前的原始 `.jsonl` 逐会话对账——消息数、逐消息 ID、时间戳、token 字段与 DurationMS 均无差异。
- **OpenCode V2 total 由派生取代暂缓。** v0.2.0 对带用量但 `tokens.total` 缺失或为 `null` 的终态消息不入账——每轮报告部分失败并保留游标等待重试。现在 total 按上游 `total()` 同源的五分项之和在单一派生点计算；V2 会话正常入账，周期性部分失败停止。
- **`log.dir` 含两端空白不再导致路径分裂。** 配置的日志目录现在统一去两端空白、展开 `~` 后由 daemon、自启、fallback 与 serve 各路径共享；此前带杂散空白的值可能在不同消费方解析出不同路径。

### 安装
见 [README 快速开始](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#快速开始)。已有用户用 `token-usage update` 原地升级。
